svg.title: Uno R3 and A3144 Hall Switch Wiring

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: J1 is a logical breakout header. Pin order: VCC, GND, open-collector OUT. Connect OUT to Uno D2 with the internal pull-up enabled. This drawing assumes a 5 V-rated device or breakout; check the exact A3144-compatible part before powering it.

g.desc: J1 is a logical breakout header. Pin order: VCC, GND, open-collector OUT. Connect OUT to Uno D2 with the internal pull-up enabled. This drawing assumes a 5 V-rated device or breakout; check the exact A3144-compatible part before powering it.

g.text: Bare A3144 packages and breakout boards can have different pinouts and supply limits. Verify the exact component and module before assembly. The active-low output does not measure magnetic-field strength. Hardware is untested.
